title: File:View of Mae Sa Valley, Chiang Mai, Thailand.jpg
claims: A hazy view over the Mae Sa valley in Mae Rim district: broad-leaved tropical trees and banana leaves fill the foreground, a steep forested ridge rises across the middle ground, and the sky is pale blue with thin cloud. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file View of Mae Sa Valley, Chiang Mai, Thailand.jpg. The route page uses it as Mae Sa valley context for the A13 Maesa Elephant Camp section of ELEPHANT 100; it does not show the camp, the aid station, the 2026 course line or race-day conditions.

The Commons author field reads VN.NguyenDucDuy; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2025-12-20 10:35:26; the file page gives a camera or subject position of 18.933675 N, 98.811775 E; the original is 5,712 × 4,284 px; 5,507,335 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 720 px; 233,689 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits VN.NguyenDucDuy, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
